# sq_

> sq_ is a client-side 3D squash game in the browser. No accounts, no backend, no network gameplay — open the URL and play.

## Primary

- [Home / play](https://sq.perniemann.com/): full game shell (React Three Fiber + Rapier)
- [Canonical](https://sq.perniemann.com/): same as home; single-page application
- [Design reference](https://sq.perniemann.com/design): public product catalog — Map, Play, Feedback, System, Kit (no secrets)

## Documentation

- [How to play](https://github.com/perniemann/sq/blob/main/docs/HOW-TO-PLAY.md): keyboard, mouse, and touch controls; scoring
- [README](https://github.com/perniemann/sq/blob/main/README.md): match briefing, then stack, scripts, deploy notes
- [Changelog](https://github.com/perniemann/sq/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history
